items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We worked in our first band together, Lloyd Hunter band. ... [INTERVIEWEE] He was a tenor man in the band when I got there up in Chicago.

ctx.x: Then another young man--did you ever know Paul Quinichette?
We worked in our first band together, Lloyd Hunter band. We picked him up in Denver, 1941.
He was a tenor man in the band when I got there up in Chicago.
